input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
input.rationale: § 14.10 restricts only Customer: we need IBM's consent (albeit not unreasonably withheld) and have a merger/consolidation/acquisition successor carve-out, but no affiliate or asset-sale carve-out. IBM, by contrast, is subject to no assignment restriction at all and could assign to one of our competitors. That one-sidedness fails the fallback, which requires a mutual right to assign to successors with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld, so it is a material deviation rather than a minor shortfall. No change-of-control termination or re-pricing right exists anywhere in the document (no "change of control" language found), so walk-away territory is not engaged on that point. Redline makes the restriction mutual, bars IBM assignment to our competitors, and adds our affiliate/asset-sale carve-out.

proposal.summary: Make assignment restriction mutual, add affiliate/asset-sale carve-out for Customer, and bar IBM assignment to our competitors
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the assignment restriction mutual and added our customary affiliate and successor (including asset sale) carve-out, since as drafted only we are restricted while IBM could assign freely, including to a competitor of ours. If helpful, we can instead accept a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice with consent for other assignments not to be unreasonably withheld.

ops.oldText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Neither party will assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and IBM will not assign this Agreement to a competitor of Customer. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets.
